limitation: An evidence-use log records declared access only. It cannot prove that nobody viewed the data outside it (another tool, a copy, a shell, a chat), and scopes, roles and viewed flags are self-declared: a mislabelled scope or flag sidesteps the checks. Holdout protection is procedural as well as technical.
